placers.name: Kenleigh Estep
placers.note: Class of 2031: a seventh grader when she placed 4 at 100 in the 2026 KHSAA championship. Kentucky let them wrestle for a member school and the medal is real, but the platform mints a profile only for a current class year (2027-2030), so a class of 2031 has nowhere to sit yet and a guessed one would be worse. The placement is stored and linked; the profile follows when 2031 enters the window. Class year from the grade the tournament published (29 Oct 2026).

preFreshmanVerified.note: Lilly Nelson, Harrison County, class of 2028. Before her freshman year she placed 6 in 2024. Kentucky allows it: the KHSAA permits playing up, the package's grade evidence carries 24 eighth-grade and 11 seventh-grade entries, and each class year here is derived from the grade the tournament published - the same field that flags the result as pre-freshman. Different from Maryland (COMAR 13A.06.03.02, grades 9-12 only) and Virginia (VHSL 28-2-1, eighth graders on junior varsity only), where the same shape proved a class year wrong (29 Oct 2026).
